name: snowbody
source:
Two young men venture out on an errand but get caught up in the fiery feelings they have for each other. One thing leads to another, and then… they discover a body?!

[From [url=https://angeluscult.itch.io/snowbody]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个年轻人冒险外出执行任务，但却陷入了彼此的炽热感情中。一件事引发另一件事，然后……他们发现了一具尸体？！

[来自[url=https://angeluscult.itch.io/snowbody]Itch.io[/url]]
